Weapon Kills grants strong projectile tracking for ? seconds. Stacks 4 times.

Dealing damage extends the buff duration.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased.
)

Kills with the weapon increase reload speed and grant strong projectile tracking for ? seconds. Stacks 4 times.

Dealing damage extends the buff duration. Buff can be activated while stowed.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased.
)

Kills with the weapon grant a Stack of Beacon Rounds for #e${6+#d} seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks.

Scoring futher Hits with the weapon can extend the buff duration up to the maximum of 4 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.

Each Stack grants increased projectile tracking. Projectile Tracking is only in effect while the Targeted Reticle is active.

Grants the following while you have active Stacks:
• 15 Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 45% Increased Auto Aim Cone size
